pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "September" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. February
   C. December
   D. September

2. Which German word is the number 3? (1 mark)
   A. achtzehn
   B. zwölf
   C. drei
   D. fünf

3. What number is "zwölf"? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 6
   C. 12
   D. 3

4. Which German word means "July"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. Juni
   C. Juli
   D. Mai

5. Which German word or phrase means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. die Banane
   B. der Reis
   C. die Mango
   D. die Wassermelone

6. Which verb goes with "Die Sonne ___"? (1 mark)
   A. scheint
   B. regnet
   C. schneit
   D. weht

7. Which German word or phrase means "see you soon"? (1 mark)
   A. Bis bald
   B. Danke
   C. Ja
   D. Bitte

8. Which form completes "Sie (she) ___ zwei Schwestern"? (1 mark)
   A. hast
   B. haben
   C. hat
   D. habe

9. What does "Guten Abend" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good night
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. What is your name?
   D. good evening

10. What does "essen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to eat
   B. to help
   C. to smell
   D. to play

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Nebel"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

12. What does "manchmal" mean? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. always
   C. sometimes
   D. never

13. Which food is usually called healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Obst
   B. Limonade
   C. Chips
   D. Zucker

14. Which sentence tells that someone likes rice and beans? (1 mark)
   A. Ich habe kein Reis.
   B. Wo ist der Reis?
   C. Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   D. Ich koche Reis und Bohnen nicht.

15. What is the plural of "der Bruder"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bruder
   B. die Bruders
   C. die Bruderen
   D. die Brüder

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)

19. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)

20. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — September
   September means September.

2. C — drei
   3 in German is drei.

3. C — 12
   zwölf is the number 12.

4. C — Juli
   July in German is Juli.

5. B — der Reis
   rice in German is der Reis.

6. A — scheint
   Die Sonne scheint means the sun shines.

7. A — Bis bald
   see you soon in German is Bis bald.

8. C — hat
   sie (she) goes with hat.

9. D — good evening
   Guten Abend means good evening.

10. A — to eat
   essen means to eat.

11. A — der
   It is der Nebel, so the little word is der.

12. C — sometimes
   manchmal means sometimes.

13. A — Obst
   Fruit (Obst) is a healthy food.

14. C — Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   gern shows that the person likes it.

15. D — die Brüder
   The plural of der Bruder is die Brüder.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.
